items.caption: The three curved strokes in this Shuowen-style seal form of 气 all extend rightward; the lowest continues into a long downward tail. It shows a labeled later form, but does not settle what the earliest reported forms represented.
items.alt: Three bold black curved strokes on white, each extending rightward; the lowest curves down into a long vertical tail.
items.selection_reason: This clearly identified seal-script rendering illustrates a later visible form of 气. Its shape does not establish the disputed meaning of the earliest forms.

limitations.text: The earliest reported forms of 气 have competing interpretations, including cloud vapor, a referential sign, a cutting-related sign, and uses linked to 迄 or 訖. This later seal-style form does not resolve their referent or establish a dated sequence of graphic change.
